name: Reconnoissance
overview: The biblical accounts of reconnoissance reveal a strategic and cautious approach by God's people as they prepared to possess the Promised Land. Joshua sent two men to secretly spy on Jericho, demonstrating reliance on careful intelligence before battle, while the house of Joseph and the tribe of Dan dispatched men to survey Bethel and Laish, respectively. These missions involved discreet observation and lodging among locals, underscoring the importance of understanding the land and its inhabitants as part of God's providential plan for Israel's conquest and settlement.
